proposed.explanation: Confuses site environmental status with architectural licensing; the Board of Architecture does not maintain environmental designations. Wrong agency; no such authority; environmental designations are maintained by DENR, not a construction industry authority. Wrong function; the Department of Budget and Management handles government finances, not environmental designations. NIPAS (National Integrated Protected Areas System) and DENR Regional Offices maintain maps and information on protected areas, biodiversity hotspots, and sensitive ecosystems. Consult NIPAS and DENR Regional Offices to determine if a proposed site is in a protected or sensitive area before proceeding with design.
